answers.why: Israel is explicitly God's people dwelling safely.
Gog comes against God's people Israel and their land.
Israel is the nation whose prophets foretold Gog's attack against them.
God makes his holy name known among his people Israel.
God is holy in Israel, the nation contrasted with the other nations.
The burial place in Israel lies in the nation's land.
God promises mercy to the whole house of Israel after their captivity.
The God of Israel is the nation's God whose glory approaches the sanctuary.
The house of Israel and their kings have defiled God's holy name.
The LORD is called the God of Israel in the nation's sanctuary.
Israel went astray after their idols alongside the Levites.
The Levites caused the house of Israel to fall into iniquity through idolatry.
The priests receive no landed possession within Israel's territory.
Dedicated things throughout Israel belong to the priests.
